chapter_path_en: Risks and Methods of Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing
chapter_path_zh: 洗钱和恐怖融资的风险及方法
display_chapter_path: 洗钱和恐怖融资的风险及方法
stem: 专业服务提供者-包括律师、会计师、投资经纪以及其他第三方-可能会滥用其职位为洗钱提供便利.这种滥用行为与哪些金融犯罪风险相关？(选择三项.)

options.A: 为客户开设账户以处理遗产事宜
options.B: 设立空壳公司以实施洗钱活动,包括资金的置入或分层操作
options.C: 为掩盖实际客户身份而开设第三方账户
options.D: 开设信托账户以促进合法的房地产交易
options.E: 指导或协助清洗非法资金,包括通过拆分(结构化)交易规避申报或监控门槛

stem_en: Professional service providers, including lawyers, accountants, investment brokers, and other third parties, may abuse their positions to facilitate money laundering. Which financial crime risks are associated with this type of abuse? (Select Three.)

options_en.A: Opening an account to settle an estate on behalf of a client
options_en.B: Establishing shell companies to enable money laundering activities, including placement or layering
options_en.C: Opening third-party accounts for the primary purpose of masking the underlying client's identity
options_en.D: Opening a trust account to facilitate a legitimate real estate transaction
options_en.E: Directing or facilitating the laundering of illicit funds, including structuring transactions
